summary: The same wrong rewrite, claimed as equality for one way of choosing, which Lean refutes
why: Until F3 both functions stopped at a frozen poison, so tgt x = src x held in the model, and tools/verify.py proved it. Equality treats a model stop as an answer, so it isn't refinement. Since F3 each freeze chooses: where tgt's two choose 0 and 1, it returns 255 and src returns 0. The gate only takes the refinement claim either way.

pin_override.statement: ∀ (x : IRLean.Val 8), Opt.tgt x (fun p => if p = [2] then 1 else 0) = Opt.src x (fun p => if p = [2] then 1 else 0)
